sources.source_ref: RA 9266 (2004), Section 33 — Ownership of Plans and Contract Documents
sources.document_title: Republic Act No. 9266 — The Architecture Act of 2004
verified_sections: Section 33, paragraph 1 — Plans, specifications, and contract documents are intellectual property of the architect
Section 33, paragraph 3 — Client may use plans only for the specific project commissioned
sources.notes: Section 33 establishes the architect's ownership of design documents and limits client use to the specific project.

sources.source_ref: RA 8293 (1997), Intellectual Property Code of the Philippines
sources.document_title: Republic Act No. 8293 — Intellectual Property Code of the Philippines
verified_sections: Section 172.1 — Original architectural works protected by copyright
Section 177 — Right of reproduction (copyright owner's exclusive right)
Section 211 — Moral rights of the creator
sources.notes: RA 8293 provides additional copyright protection for architectural works, reinforcing Section 33 of RA 9266.
